source_container.trajectory_semantics: native numerical particle identity; not material identity
source_container.compatibility_note: This describes the proposed F8 fluid-only table using the Core HDF5 layout. The current generic converter is not asserted to enforce the strict raw-frame membership checks below; an F8 adapter must validate before projecting rows.

time.semantics: strictly increasing native solver times in seconds; require row 0 to equal exactly 0.0

particle_id.semantics: unique, immutable, sorted fluid IDs declared by the hash-bound generated Definition

mass.semantics: native particle mass; finite, positive, and invariant for each particle_id

valid.semantics: true only when the corresponding native fluid ID was decoded exactly once; all entries must be true for selected rows

fluid_cohort.membership_source: hash-bound generated XML fluid particle groups for this exact matrix row
fluid_cohort.pre_projection_raw_frame_check: derive the complete expected native ID universe from the generated XML particle groups and bind its hash; in each decoded native frame require every expected ID exactly once and reject every missing, duplicate, changed, or unknown ID; classify registered fluid IDs versus registered boundary/nonfluid IDs, then project only the exact fluid cohort
fluid_cohort.classification_failure: if generated XML particle groups do not uniquely and completely classify the expected native ID universe, fail closed before table creation

initial_fluid_table.validation: all IDs unique; all initial coordinates and masses finite; all masses strictly positive; every z maps to exactly one registered plane within max(1e-6*dp_m,1e-9 m)

per_frame_validation.selected_native_rows: inclusive exact rows returned by select_closed_native_window; no interpolation or synthesized rows
per_frame_validation.valid: all true for every selected fluid row
per_frame_validation.velocity_and_position: all finite for every selected fluid row
per_frame_validation.mass: all finite, positive, and unchanged by particle_id from row 0
per_frame_validation.failure_policy: fail the case closed before any profile, flux, or transverse-RMS reduction
